orbProfile.normalization: vl-rgb-v1, sampled RGBA composited on white, integer BT.601 gray
orbProfile.evidence: orb-candidate; geometric support, not identity or leakage probability
orbProfile.pairOrder: input prefix, earlier partners first; smaller sampled image is query first, opposite direction if no hit; existing Core pairs retained without replacement

retrieval.selection: symmetric top-1 union; one vote per query descriptor/image; Core pairs excluded

coverage.summary: 已审计 train 0 / validation 0 / test 50；拒收/错误 0；忽略 0；已发现但未审计 50；结论只覆盖已审计输入与已完成比较。
